title.zh: 卷425 列傳二百十二 李僡 吴棠 英翰 刘蓉 乔松年 钱鼎铭 吴元炳
title.en: Volume 425 Biographies 212: Li Hui, Wu Tang, Ying Han, Liu Rong, Qiao Songnian, Qian Dingming, Wu Yuanbing
title.raw: 卷425 列傳二百十二 李僡 吴棠 英翰 刘蓉 乔松年 钱鼎铭 吴元炳

sentences.zh: =李僡=李僡，字惠人，陝西華陰人。

translations.literal: Li Hui, style name Huiren, was a native of Huayin in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hui, whose style was Huiren, came from Huayin in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 道光二年進士，直隸即用知縣，補撫寧，調青縣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed an expectant magistrate in Zhili, filled the post at Funing, and was transferred to Qing County.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the second year of Daoguang, entered service as an expectant magistrate in Zhili, took up Funing, and was later moved to Qing County.

sentences.zh: 舉卓異，歷滄州、深州，擢大名知府。

translations.literal: Rated outstanding, he served successively at Cangzhou and Shenzhou and was promoted to prefect of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: After an outstanding merit rating he served in Cangzhou and Shenzhou in turn before being promoted to prefect of Daming.

sentences.zh: 調保定，擢大順廣道，遷按察使。

translations.literal: Transferred to Baoding, he was promoted to intendant of the Da-Shun-Guang Circuit and then moved to provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Baoding, promoted to intendant of the Da-Shun-Guang Circuit, and later appointed provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，擢順天府尹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to governor of Shuntian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In his twenty-first year of service he was raised to governor of Shuntian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，南河決，命偕侍郎成剛馳往督工。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the South River burst its banks; he was ordered to proceed with Vice Minister Cheng Gang to supervise the works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, when the South River breached its banks, he was sent with Vice Minister Cheng Gang to oversee repairs on an urgent commission.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，出為江蘇布政使，以病歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he went out as Jiangsu provincial treasurer but returned home on account of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was appointed Jiangsu provincial treasurer, but illness forced him to retire home.

sentences.zh: 三十年，起授甘肅布政使。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was recalled and appointed Gansu provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was recalled to office as Gansu provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，擢河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he was promoted to governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he was made governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 長蘆鹽政疲敝，言官請變通懸岸，僡偕直隸總督訥爾經額議改直、豫懸岸，分別官辦、商販。

translations.literal: The Changlu salt administration was exhausted; censors requested reform of the suspended-shore system. Hui together with the Zhili governor-general Ne'erjing'e deliberated on changing the Zhili and Henan suspended shores, dividing them between government operation and merchant distribution.
translations.idiomatic: When the Changlu salt administration fell into decay, censors called for reforms to the suspended-shore system. Hui joined Zhili governor-general Ne'erjing'e in planning changes to the Zhili and Henan shores, splitting management between official operation and merchant sales.

sentences.zh: 二年，調山東。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he was transferred to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 粵匪由武昌東下趨江寧，僡遣精兵二千馳援，親赴兗、沂、曹諸府察形勢，分兵扼隘防守。

translations.literal: The Taiping rebels marched east from Wuchang toward Jiangning; Hui dispatched two thousand elite troops in urgent relief, went in person to Yanzhou, Yizhou, and Caozhou to survey the terrain, and divided his forces to hold passes and defend.
translations.idiomatic: As the Taiping rebels advanced east from Wuchang toward Jiangning, Hui sent two thousand picked troops to reinforce the defense, inspected conditions in person across Yanzhou, Yizhou, and Caozhou, and deployed detachments to guard the strategic passes.

sentences.zh: 履行河堤，令黃河渡船悉歸曹縣劉家口、單縣董家口，斷他口私渡。

translations.literal: He inspected the river dikes, ordered all Yellow River ferry boats to be concentrated at Liujiakou in Caoxian and Dongjiakou in Shanxian, and cut off unauthorized crossings elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: He toured the river dikes, concentrated Yellow River ferries at Liujiakou in Caoxian and Dongjiakou in Shanxian, and shut down illicit crossings at other points.

sentences.zh: 檄候補道慶凱等駐兵要隘，搜捕捻匪。

translations.literal: He issued orders to the expectant circuit intendant Qing Kai and others to garrison strategic passes and hunt down Nian bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He directed expectant circuit intendant Qing Kai and others to hold the key passes and hunt down Nian rebels.

sentences.zh: 三年，江寧陷，徐州捻、梟諸匪蜂起，僡再赴兗、沂、曹諸府督防。

translations.literal: In the third year Jiangning fell; Nian and outlaw bands rose in swarms at Xuzhou; Hui again went to Yanzhou, Yizhou, and Caozhou to supervise defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, after Jiangning fell, Nian rebels and local outlaw bands flared up around Xuzhou, and Hui returned to Yanzhou, Yizhou, and Caozhou to direct the defenses.

sentences.zh: 未幾，揚州陷，僡令防軍分三路：游擊王鳳祥等駐郯縣紅花埠為東南路，總兵百勝等駐嶧縣韓莊閘及陰平為中路，總兵三星保巡劉家、董家二口，遏賊北竄，為西南路。

translations.literal: Before long Yangzhou fell; Hui ordered the defense forces divided into three routes: Colonel Wang Fengxiang and others stationed at Honghuabu in Tancheng as the southeast route; Brigadier Bai Sheng and others at Hanzhuang Sluice in Yixian and at Yinping as the center route; Brigadier Sanxingbao patrolling the Liujia and Dongjia crossings to block the rebels' northward flight as the southwest route.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Yangzhou fell. Hui split his defensive forces into three lines: Colonel Wang Fengxiang held Honghuabu in Tancheng on the southeast; Brigadier Bai Sheng held Hanzhuang Sluice in Yixian and Yinping on the center; and Brigadier Sanxingbao patrolled the Liujia and Dongjia crossings to stop any rebel drive northward on the southwest.

sentences.zh: 傳駐宿遷迤北，與百勝等犄角。

translations.literal: Fu was stationed north of Suqian in mutual support with Bai Sheng and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Fu took position north of Suqian, coordinating with Bai Sheng's force in a pincer defense.

sentences.zh: 四月，賊自浦口北竄安徽，陷滁州，逼鳳陽臨淮關。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the rebels fled north from Pukou into Anhui, captured Chuzhou, and pressed Fengyang and Linhuaiguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the rebels broke north from Pukou into Anhui, took Chuzhou, and threatened Fengyang and Linhuaiguan.

sentences.zh: 僡進駐宿遷，慮徐州守兵弱，請移山西、陝西、綏遠諸路援兵策應。

translations.literal: Hui advanced to Suqian, fearing the garrison at Xuzhou was weak, and requested that relief troops from Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Suiyuan be shifted to support him.
translations.idiomatic: Hui moved forward to Suqian. Concerned that Xuzhou was thinly held, he asked that reinforcements from Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Suiyuan be redeployed to support his line.

sentences.zh: 五月，賊自亳州經米家集竄河南，陷歸德、擾劉家口。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the rebels fled from Bozhou through Mijiaji into Henan, captured Guide, and harassed Liujiakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the rebels slipped from Bozhou through Mijiaji into Henan, seized Guide, and raided Liujiakou.

sentences.zh: 僡命防軍進擊，民團繼之，毀北岸船，賊不得渡。

translations.literal: Hui ordered the defense forces to attack; militia followed; boats on the north bank were destroyed, and the rebels could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: Hui sent his defenders forward with local militia in support, destroyed the boats on the north bank, and kept the rebels from crossing.

sentences.zh: 有由曹河駛入者，乘半渡擊沉之，賊敗退。

translations.literal: When some entered by the Cao River channel, he struck them mid-crossing and sank them; the rebels were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Any who tried to enter by the Cao River channel were attacked midstream and sunk, and the rebels fell back in defeat.

sentences.zh: 尋自河南汜水北渡溫縣，西路告警，僡自曹州分兵馳援，督師繼之。

translations.literal: Soon they crossed the Si River in Henan northward into Wen County; the western route sounded the alarm; Hui divided troops from Caozhou to rush relief and followed with the main army.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels soon crossed the Si River in Henan and pushed north into Wen County, raising alarms on the western front. Hui detached troops from Caozhou for urgent relief and followed with his main force.

sentences.zh: 比賊圍懷慶，僡會諸軍力戰，解其圍。

translations.literal: When the rebels besieged Huaiqing, Hui joined the various armies in fierce fighting and lifted the siege.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels besieged Huaiqing, Hui joined the allied armies in a hard fight and broke the siege.

sentences.zh: 捻匪擾歸德境，毗連曹、單、僡留陝、甘兵九百會剿，自引師回防東路。

translations.literal: Nian bandits harassed the border of Guide, adjoining Caoxian and Shanxian; Hui left nine hundred Shaanxi and Gansu troops for joint suppression and led his army back to defend the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels raided the Guide frontier near Caoxian and Shanxian. Hui left nine hundred Shaanxi and Gansu troops to pursue them jointly and led his main force back to hold the eastern line.

sentences.zh: 自粵匪起，所至各行省皆瓦解，疆吏能禦賊不使入境且出境勦賊者，惟僡一人。

translations.literal: From the rise of the Taiping rebellion, every province the rebels reached collapsed; among frontier officials able to keep rebels from entering their territory and even to pursue them beyond the border, Hui alone stood out.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taiping rebellion erupted, province after province fell apart wherever the rebels passed; of all the frontier officials, only Hui both kept the enemy from entering his jurisdiction and drove them back across the border.

sentences.zh: 文宗深嘉之，屢欲擢任總督，以山東為畿輔屏蔽，倚僡為重，故未果。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong greatly praised him and repeatedly wished to promote him to governor-general, but because Shandong was the shield of the capital region and the court relied heavily on Hui, the promotion was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong admired him deeply and several times meant to make him a governor-general, yet Shandong was the capital's outer shield and the court leaned on Hui too heavily to move him, so the appointment never came through.

sentences.zh: 尋卒於官，優詔悼惜，贈總督、太子少保，諡恭毅。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died in office; an edict of special mourning was issued; he was posthumously granted governor-general rank and Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous title Gongyi.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died in office. The throne issued a gracious edict of mourning, posthumously raised him to governor-general and Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and gave him the posthumous name Gongyi.

sentences.zh: 子啟詔，署湖南桂陽州，殉難，贈道銜。

translations.literal: His son Qi Zhao, acting prefect of Guiyang in Hunan, died in service and was granted the rank of circuit intendant posthumously.
translations.idiomatic: His son Qi Zhao, who was acting prefect of Guiyang in Hunan, died in the line of duty and was posthumously granted circuit-intendant rank.

sentences.zh: =吳棠=吳棠，字仲宣，安徽盱眙人。

translations.literal: Wu Tang, style name Zhongxuan, was a native of Xuyi in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Tang, whose style was Zhongxuan, came from Xuyi in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 道光十五年舉人，大挑知縣，分南河，補桃源。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination, was selected as magistrate in the great assignment, was posted to the South River administration, and filled Taoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He became a provincial graduate in the fifteenth year of Daoguang, was chosen as a magistrate in the great assignment, was assigned to the South River service, and took up Taoyuan.

sentences.zh: 調清河，署邳州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Qinghe and acted as magistrate of Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to Qinghe and served concurrently as acting magistrate of Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 山東捻匪入境，率團勇擊走之，還清河。

translations.literal: When Shandong Nian bandits entered his jurisdiction, he led militia to drive them off and returned to Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian rebels from Shandong crossed the border, he led local militia to beat them back and returned to Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，粵匪陷揚州，時圖北竄，棠招集鄉勇，分設七十二局，合數万人，聯絡鄰近十餘縣，合力防禦，有聲江、淮間。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng the Taiping rebels captured Yangzhou and were then plotting to flee north; Tang gathered local militia, divided them into seventy-two bureaus totaling tens of thousands of men, linked more than ten neighboring counties, and defended jointly, gaining renown between the Yangtze and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng, after the Taiping rebels took Yangzhou and turned north, Tang rallied local militia into seventy-two bureaus totaling tens of thousands of men, coordinated defenses with more than ten neighboring counties, and became celebrated throughout the Jiang-Huai region.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，士民攀留，河道總督楊以增疏請令治喪百日後，仍署清河。

translations.literal: When he entered mourning for his mother, scholars and commoners begged him to stay; the Grand Canal director-general Yang Yizeng memorialized asking that after a hundred days of mourning he still act at Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: When he went into mourning for his mother, local gentry and commoners pleaded with him to remain. Canal director-general Yang Yizeng memorialized that after a hundred days of mourning he should continue to serve at Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 太常寺少卿王茂廕疏薦，詔詢以增，亦以治績上，特命以同知直隸州即補，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wang Maoyin memorialized recommending him; the throne inquired of Yang Yizeng, who also reported his administrative achievements; he was specially ordered immediate appointment as subprefect of Zhili Prefecture and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Maoyin of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices recommended him in a memorial. The throne asked Yang Yizeng, who likewise praised his record, and Tang was specially ordered to immediate appointment as subprefect of Zhili Prefecture with the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 六年，丁父憂，仍留江蘇，以剿匪功，累擢以道員即補。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he entered mourning for his father but remained in Jiangsu; for suppressing bandits he was repeatedly promoted to immediate appointment as circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he mourned his father yet stayed in Jiangsu, and for his success against bandits he was repeatedly advanced to immediate appointment as circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 十年，補淮徐道，命幫辦江北團練。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he filled the Huai-Xu circuit post and was ordered to assist in organizing militia north of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he took up the Huai-Xu circuit and was ordered to help organize militia in northern Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 皖北捻匪出入，以徐、宿為孔道，山東土匪時相勾結，一歲數擾，棠督軍屢擊走之。

translations.literal: Nian bandits in northern Anhui moved in and out with Xuzhou and Suzhou as their thoroughfare; Shandong outlaws often colluded with them and raided several times in a year; Tang directed troops and repeatedly drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels in northern Anhui used the Xuzhou-Suzhou corridor as their main route, often in league with Shandong brigands, and raided repeatedly through the year. Tang commanded the troops and beat them back again and again.

sentences.zh: 十一年，擢江寧布政使，署漕運總督，督辦江北糧台，轄江北鎮、道以下，令總兵龔耀倫等破賊於阜寧、山陽，解安東圍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Jiangning provincial treasurer, acted as director-general of grain transport, supervised the northern Jiangsu grain depot, and had authority over all brigades and circuits north of the Yangtze; he ordered Brigadier Gong Yaolun and others to defeat rebels at Funing and Shanyang and relieve the siege of Andong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he became Jiangning provincial treasurer and acting director-general of grain transport, took charge of the northern Jiangsu grain depot with authority over the brigades and circuits north of the river, and ordered Brigadier Gong Yaolun and others to defeat the rebels at Funing and Shanyang and lift the siege of Andong.

sentences.zh: 漕督舊駐淮安府城，棠以清江浦地當衝要，築土城駐之。

translations.literal: The grain-transport director-general had formerly been stationed in Huai'an prefectural city; Tang, because Qingjiangpu lay on a strategic point, built an earthen walled camp and stationed himself there.
translations.idiomatic: The grain-transport governor had long been based in Huai'an city, but Tang judged Qingjiangpu the critical point, built an earthen walled camp there, and made it his headquarters.

sentences.zh: 捻匪大舉來撲，督軍力戰擊退，賊踞眾興集相持，令驍將陳國瑞進攻，戰十日，大破之，賊遁泗州。

translations.literal: Nian bandits came in force to attack; he directed the army in fierce fighting and drove them back; the rebels held Zhongxingji in stalemate; he ordered the fierce general Chen Guorui to attack; after ten days of battle they were heavily defeated and fled to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian rebels struck in force, he led a hard fight and threw them back. The enemy held Zhongxingji in a standoff until he sent Chen Guorui forward; after ten days of battle the rebels were shattered and fled toward Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 督屬縣築圩寨，堅壁清野，收撫海州，贛榆土匪，先後遣將擊捻匪，擒李麻子於曹八集，斬何申元於洞里莊，殲卜裡於半截樓，又破山東幅匪於郯城徐家圩、鎰陽集、長城等處。

translations.literal: He ordered subordinate counties to build stockaded villages and clear the countryside; he pacified bandits in Haizhou and Ganyu; he successively sent generals against Nian rebels, capturing Li Mazi at Caobaji, beheading He Shenyuan at Donglizhuang, destroying Bu Li at Banjielou, and also defeating Shandong roving bandits at Xujiawei in Tancheng, Yiyangji, Changcheng, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: He had the subordinate counties build fortified stockades and clear the countryside, pacified outlaws in Haizhou and Ganyu, and sent generals in succession against the Nian: Li Mazi was captured at Caobaji, He Shenyuan beheaded at Donglizhuang, Bu Li wiped out at Banjielou, and Shandong roving bandits broken at Xujiawei in Tancheng, Yiyangji, Changcheng, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，實授漕運總督。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he received formal appointment as director-general of grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi he was formally appointed director-general of grain transport.

sentences.zh: 令陳國瑞進剿沂州，迭殲渠魁，國瑞遂隸僧格林沁軍。

translations.literal: He ordered Chen Guorui to advance against Yizhou and repeatedly destroyed rebel chiefs; Chen Guorui then came under Sengge Rinchen's army.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Chen Guorui to campaign in Yizhou, where one rebel chief after another was destroyed, after which Chen Guorui entered Sengge Rinchen's command.

sentences.zh: 苗沛霖叛陷壽州，棠令總兵姚慶武、黃開榜水陸赴援。

translations.literal: Miao Peilin rebelled and captured Shouzhou; Tang ordered Brigadiers Yao Qingwu and Huang Kaibang to go by land and water to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: When Miao Peilin rebelled and took Shouzhou, Tang sent Brigadiers Yao Qingwu and Huang Kaibang overland and by water to its relief.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「欲拯臨淮之急，必須一軍由宿、蒙直搗懷遠，使苗逆急於回顧，臨淮始可保全。

translations.literal: In a memorial he said: "To relieve the crisis at Linhuai, one army must strike straight from Suzhou and Mengcheng toward Huaiyuan so that the rebel Miao will be forced to turn back; only then can Linhuai be preserved."
translations.idiomatic: He wrote in a memorial: "To save Linhuai, a force must drive straight from Suzhou and Mengcheng against Huaiyuan and force Miao to turn back; only then can Linhuai be held."

sentences.zh: 削平之策，尤須數道進兵，方能制其死命。

translations.literal: The strategy for complete suppression especially requires advancing on several routes before his life can be taken.
translations.idiomatic: To crush him completely, troops must advance on several fronts at once.

sentences.zh: 」又密陳：「皖北隱患，淮北鹽務疲敝，悉由李世忠盤剝把持，其勇隊在懷、壽一方盤踞六年，焚掠甚於盜賊。

translations.literal: " He also secretly reported: "The hidden trouble in northern Anhui and the exhaustion of salt affairs in northern Huai all stem from Li Shizhong's extortion and control; his braves have occupied the Huai-Shou region for six years, burning and plundering worse than bandits."
translations.idiomatic: " He also submitted a secret memorial: "Northern Anhui's underlying trouble and the decay of northern Huai salt affairs all come from Li Shizhong's extortion and grip on power. His braves have held the Huai-Shou region for six years, looting worse than common bandits."

sentences.zh: 苗平而淮北粗安，李存而淮南仍困，請早為之計。

translations.literal: If Miao is pacified northern Huai will be roughly secure, but if Li remains southern Huai will still suffer; please plan early.
translations.idiomatic: Pacify Miao and northern Huai may recover a measure of peace; leave Li in place and southern Huai will remain in distress. I beg that this be planned in advance.

sentences.zh: 」詔下僧格林沁等籌辦。

translations.literal: " An edict was issued to Sengge Rinchen and others to deliberate and carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne ordered Sengge Rinchen and others to take the matter in hand.

sentences.zh: 三年，加頭品頂戴，署江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: In the third year he was granted the first-class official's hat button and acted as governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he received the first-class hat button and served as acting governor of Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 四年，調署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to act as governor-general of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to serve as acting governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 棠疏陳：「江境尚未全平，請收回成命，專辦清淮防剿。

translations.literal: Tang memorialized: "The Jiangsu frontier is not yet fully pacified; I beg that the appointment be withdrawn and that I be allowed to devote myself solely to defense and suppression on the Qing-Huai front."
translations.idiomatic: Tang memorialized: "The Jiangsu frontier is not yet fully pacified. I ask that the order be rescinded so that I may devote myself entirely to defense and suppression along the Qing-Huai line."

sentences.zh: 」詔嘉其不避難就易，仍留漕督任。

translations.literal: " The edict praised him for not shunning hardship to seek ease and kept him in the grain-transport post.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne praised him for refusing the easier post and left him in charge of grain transport.

sentences.zh: 軍事初定，即籌复河運。

translations.literal: As soon as military affairs were initially settled, he began planning to restore canal transport.
translations.idiomatic: Once fighting had subsided, he set about restoring the canal transport system.

sentences.zh: 署兩江總督，未幾，回任。

translations.literal: He acted as governor-general of the Two Jiangs; before long he returned to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: He briefly served as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs, then soon returned to his former duties.

sentences.zh: 五年，調閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 六年，調四川總督。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to governor-general of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made governor-general of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 時蜀中軍事久定，養兵尚多，而協濟秦、隴、滇、黔，歲餉不貲。

translations.literal: At the time military affairs in Shu had long been settled, yet many troops were still maintained, while aid was supplied to Shaanxi, Gansu, Yunnan, and Guizhou, and annual pay could not be met.
translations.idiomatic: By then Sichuan's wars had long ended, yet the province still maintained a large army while subsidizing Shaanxi, Gansu, Yunnan, and Guizhou, and annual military expenses could not be covered.

sentences.zh: 棠令道員唐炯剿貴州龍井苗匪，复麻哈州。

translations.literal: Tang ordered Circuit Intendant Tang Jiong to suppress the Longjing Miao bandits in Guizhou and recover Mahazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tang sent Circuit Intendant Tang Jiong against the Longjing Miao rebels in Guizhou and recovered Mahazhou.

sentences.zh: 道員張文玉等克黃平州，疏請遣周達武一軍入黔助剿，即調達武貴州提督，餉仍由四川任之。

translations.literal: Circuit Intendant Zhang Wenyu and others captured Huangping Prefecture; he memorialized requesting that one army under Zhou Dawu enter Guizhou to assist suppression; Zhou Dawu was then transferred to Guizhou provincial military commissioner, with pay still borne by Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenyu and others took Huangping Prefecture. Tang memorialized for an army under Zhou Dawu to enter Guizhou as reinforcement, appointed Zhou Dawu provincial military commissioner of Guizhou, and kept his supplies charged to Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 平苗之役，賴其力焉。

translations.literal: The campaign to pacify the Miao relied on his strength.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign to pacify the Miao depended heavily on his support.

sentences.zh: 八年，雲貴總督劉岳昭劾棠赴川時僕從需索屬員饋送，言官亦劾道員鍾峻等包攬招搖，命湖廣總督李鴻章往按。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Liu Yuezhao impeached Tang because when he went to Sichuan his attendants demanded gifts from subordinates; censors also impeached Circuit Intendant Zhong Jun and others for monopolizing patronage and solicitation; Li Hongzhang, governor-general of Huguang, was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Liu Yuezhao of Yunnan-Guizhou impeached Tang for allowing his attendants to extort gifts from subordinates on his arrival in Sichuan. Censors also accused Zhong Jun and others of patronage and solicitation. Li Hongzhang of Huguang was sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 鴻章覆奏：「川省習尚鑽營，棠遇事整頓，猾吏造言騰謗。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang reported in reply: "Sichuan is accustomed to intrigue; Tang has been strict in handling affairs, and crafty clerks have fabricated slander and spread it abroad."
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang replied: "Sichuan is steeped in intrigue. Tang has been tightening discipline, and slippery officials have invented slander against him."

sentences.zh: 」詔責棠力加整飭，勿稍瞻顧，斥岳昭率奏失實，惟坐失察鍾峻等薄譴。

translations.literal: " An edict reproved Tang to tighten discipline vigorously without hesitation, rebuked Liu Yuezhao for rash and inaccurate memorializing, and only imposed light punishment on Zhong Jun and others for failure of supervision.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne ordered Tang to tighten discipline without holding back, rebuked Liu Yuezhao for careless and unfounded accusations, and imposed only mild penalties on Zhong Jun and others for lax oversight.

sentences.zh: 十年，署成都將軍，奏撥捐輸銀二十萬兩賑饑民。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he acted as general of Chengdu, memorialized allocating two hundred thousand taels of contribution silver to relieve famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he served as acting general of Chengdu and memorialized for two hundred thousand taels of contribution silver to relieve famine victims.

sentences.zh: 十三年，雲南、貴州軍事先後肅清，以協餉功被優敘。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the military affairs of Yunnan and Guizhou were successively pacified; for his merit in supplying funds he received special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the wars in Yunnan and Guizhou were successively brought to order, and he received special commendation for supplying military funds.

sentences.zh: 灌縣山匪作亂，令提督李有恆剿平之，斬其渠余其隆。

translations.literal: Mountain bandits in Guan County rebelled; he ordered Provincial Military Commissioner Li Youheng to suppress them and beheaded their leader Yu Qilong.
translations.idiomatic: When mountain bandits rose in Guan County, he sent Provincial Military Commissioner Li Youheng to suppress them and had their leader Yu Qilong executed.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「部章新班遇缺先人員補官較易，服官川省者，報捐不惜重利借貸，其中即有可用之才，夙累既重，心有所分，官債雖清，民生必困。

translations.literal: In a memorial he said: "Under the new ministry regulations, candidates with prior seniority in filling vacancies obtain office more easily. Those serving in Sichuan, when purchasing office, do not hesitate to borrow at heavy interest; among them are men of talent, but once burdened with long-standing debts their minds are divided; though official debt is cleared, the people's livelihood must suffer."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Under the new ministry rules, candidates with seniority in the vacancy queue gain office more easily. Officials in Sichuan who purchase posts borrow at ruinous interest without hesitation. Some are capable men, yet once crushed by debt their attention is divided: even if official debt is cleared, the people still suffer."

sentences.zh: 請敕部另議變通，俾試用甄別年滿、歷練較久諸員，得有敘補之期，實於吏治有益。

translations.literal: I beg the ministry to deliberate on another flexible method so that probationary officials who have completed screening and those of longer experience may have a period for regular promotion; this would truly benefit administration.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ministry devise a more flexible rule so probationary officials who have completed screening and those with longer experience may finally receive regular promotion; that would truly improve governance.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，剿敘永廳匪及雷波叛蠻，平之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he suppressed bandits in Xuyong Subprefecture and rebellious barbarians in Leibo and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu he suppressed bandits in Xuyong and rebellious tribes in Leibo and restored order.

sentences.zh: 以病乞罷。

translations.literal: On account of illness he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: Illness forced him to request retirement.

sentences.zh: 二年，卒，詔優恤，諡勤惠。

translations.literal: In the second year he died; an edict granted special mourning favors; his posthumous title was Qinhui.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year. The throne granted special mourning honors and gave him the posthumous name Qinhui.

sentences.zh: =英翰=英翰，字西林，薩爾圖氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Ying Han, style name Xilin, of the Sartu clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Han, whose style was Xilin, belonged to the Sartu clan and came from the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光二十九年舉人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a provincial graduate in the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，揀發安徽，以知縣用。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he was selected and dispatched to Anhui for use as magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he was selected for service in Anhui as a magistrate.

sentences.zh: 九年，署合肥。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he acted as magistrate of Hefei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he served as acting magistrate of Hefei.

sentences.zh: 粵匪擾皖北，督鄉團擊敗之。

translations.literal: When Taiping rebels harassed northern Anhui, he directed local militia and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When Taiping rebels raided northern Anhui, he led local militia and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 又破賊華子岡、小河灣，擢同知。

translations.literal: He again defeated rebels at Huazigang and Xiaohewan and was promoted to subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated the rebels at Huazigang and Xiaohewan and was promoted to subprefect.

sentences.zh: 十一年，署宿州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he acted as prefect of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he served as acting prefect of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，捻匪來犯，英翰偕總兵田在田克高黃山寨，進破湖溝，擢知府，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, when Nian bandits attacked, Ying Han together with Brigadier Tian Zaitian captured Gaohuangshan Stockade, advanced and broke Hugou, was promoted to prefect, and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, when Nian rebels attacked, Ying Han and Brigadier Tian Zaitian took Gaohuangshan Stockade, pushed on to break Hugou, and he was promoted to prefect and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二年，捻首張洛行為僧格林沁大軍所敗，回老巢，英翰擊敗之於青甿。

translations.literal: In the second year the Nian chief Zhang Luoxing was defeated by Sengge Rinchen's main army and returned to his old lair; Ying Han defeated him at Qingmeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Nian leader Zhang Luoxing, beaten by Sengge Rinchen's main force, retreated to his old base, and Ying Han defeated him at Qingmeng.

sentences.zh: 會攻克雉河集，英翰授策降人，擒洛行送僧格林沁大營誅之，授潁州知府。

translations.literal: When Zhiji was captured, Ying Han gave strategy to defectors, captured Luoxing and sent him to Sengge Rinchen's headquarters for execution, and was appointed prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhiji fell, Ying Han worked through defectors to capture Luoxing and sent him to Sengge Rinchen's headquarters for execution; he was then appointed prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 巡撫唐訓方及袁甲三交章薦英翰沉勇有謀，剿澮北匪圩功多。

translations.literal: Governors Tang Xunfang and Yuan Jiasan jointly memorialized recommending Ying Han as deep, brave, and resourceful, with many achievements in suppressing rebel stockades north of the Hui River.
translations.idiomatic: Governors Tang Xunfang and Yuan Jiasan jointly recommended Ying Han as resolute, brave, and shrewd, citing his many successes against rebel stockades north of the Hui River.

sentences.zh: 苗沛霖复叛，攻蒙城、壽州，英翰督兵攻克蒙城附近賊圩，又擊敗沛霖所遣攻壽州兵。

translations.literal: Miao Peilin rebelled again and attacked Mengcheng and Shouzhou; Ying Han directed troops to capture rebel stockades near Mengcheng and again defeated the force Miao Peilin sent against Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Miao Peilin rebelled again and attacked Mengcheng and Shouzhou, Ying Han took the nearby rebel stockades and also defeated the force Miao sent against Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 會總兵姚廣武破韓村賊寨，攻狼山，賊棄壘遁，蒙城糧道始通。

translations.literal: Brigadier Yao Guangwu broke the rebel stockade at Hancun and attacked Langshan; the rebels abandoned their fort and fled; the grain route to Mengcheng was then opened.
translations.idiomatic: Brigadier Yao Guangwu broke the rebel camp at Hancun and attacked Langshan; the rebels abandoned their fort and fled, and Mengcheng's supply line was finally restored.

sentences.zh: 署廬鳳道，擢按察使。

translations.literal: He acted as Luzhou-Fengyang circuit intendant and was promoted to provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting Luzhou-Fengyang circuit intendant and was promoted to provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 复督兵援蒙城，攻蔡家圩，斷賊糧道，遣參將程文炳等四出截擊，夷賊壘數十。

translations.literal: Again he directed troops to relieve Mengcheng, attacked Caijia Stockade, cut the rebels' grain route, and sent Colonel Cheng Wenbing and others in four directions to intercept; dozens of rebel forts were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: He again led troops to relieve Mengcheng, attacked Caijia Stockade, severed the rebels' supply line, and sent Colonel Cheng Wenbing and others on four sides to intercept, destroying dozens of rebel forts.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁、富明阿諸軍先後至，大破賊，沛霖就殲，附沛霖諸圩盡克，賜號格洪額巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The armies of Sengge Rinchen, Fu Ming'a, and others arrived in succession, heavily defeated the rebels, Miao Peilin was destroyed, all stockades attached to him were captured, and he was granted the title Gehong'e Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen, Fu Ming'a, and other armies arrived in turn, routed the rebels, destroyed Miao Peilin, captured all stockades under him, and Ying Han was granted the title Gehong'e Baturu.

sentences.zh: 三年，粵匪合捻匪由陝南竄湖北，將遙為江寧聲援，其鋒甚銳。

translations.literal: In the third year Taiping rebels together with Nian bandits fled from southern Shaanxi into Hubei, intending to support Jiangning from afar; their momentum was very sharp.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Taiping and Nian forces broke from southern Shaanxi into Hubei to support Jiangning from a distance, and their advance was fierce.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁調英翰赴援，賊方圍麻城，襲破柏子塔賊屯，賊渠陳得才等自白臬走閻家河，英翰督軍迎戰，破之。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen transferred Ying Han to relieve them; the rebels were besieging Macheng; he stormed and broke the rebel camp at Baizita; rebel chiefs Chen Decai and others fled from Baixian to Yanjiahe; Ying Han directed the army to meet them in battle and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen sent Ying Han to reinforce Hubei while the rebels were besieging Macheng. Ying Han stormed the rebel camp at Baizita; when Chen Decai and other chiefs fled from Baixian toward Yanjiahe, he met them in battle and routed them.

sentences.zh: 尋以請獎冒濫，奪勇號，降五級留任。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, for requesting rewards excessively, his brave title was stripped and he was demoted five ranks but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon stripped of his brave title and demoted five ranks for excessive reward claims, though he was kept in office.

sentences.zh: 賊自松子關竄皖境，巡撫喬松年奏調英翰回援，克金家寨。

translations.literal: The rebels fled from Songziguan into Anhui; Governor Qiao Songnian memorialized to transfer Ying Han back for relief and captured Jinjiazhai.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels broke from Songziguan into Anhui, Governor Qiao Songnian had Ying Han recalled to reinforce the province, and Jinjiazhai was taken.

sentences.zh: 賊竄六安、青山，會諸軍擊走之。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Lu'an and Qingshan; he joined the various armies and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled toward Lu'an and Qingshan, and he joined the allied armies in driving them off.

sentences.zh: 群賊麕聚英山、霍山，連破之於樂兒嶺、土門、黑石渡。

translations.literal: Bands of rebels gathered at Yingshan and Huoshan; he defeated them in succession at Le'erling, Tumen, and Heishidu.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel bands massed at Yingshan and Huoshan, and he defeated them in succession at Le'erling, Tumen, and Heishidu.

sentences.zh: 時江寧已下，僧格林沁大軍進逼，賊皆攜貳，陳得才仰藥死。

translations.literal: At the time Jiangning had already fallen; Sengge Rinchen's main army pressed forward; the rebels all wavered; Chen Decai took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning had already fallen, Sengge Rinchen's main force was closing in, and the rebels began to waver; Chen Decai took poison and died.

sentences.zh: 馬融和有眾數万，英翰令郭寶昌招致之。

translations.literal: Ma Ronghe had a following of tens of thousands; Ying Han ordered Guo Baochang to induce him to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Ronghe commanded tens of thousands of men, and Ying Han sent Guo Baochang to win him over.

sentences.zh: 賊首藍成春亦降，餘小頭目紛紛求撫。

translations.literal: The rebel chief Lan Chengcun also surrendered, and the remaining minor leaders one after another sought pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel chief Lan Chengcun also surrendered, and lesser leaders came forward one after another seeking amnesty.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁以成春乃粵中老賊，斬之以徇。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen, because Chengcun was an old rebel from Guangdong, beheaded him as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen had Chengcun executed as an example, deeming him an old rebel chieftain from Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 未至者遂散走，而張總愚、牛洛紅、任柱、賴文光等勾結复熾。

translations.literal: Those who had not arrived then scattered and fled, while Zhang Zongyu, Niu Luohong, Ren Zhu, Lai Wenguang, and others colluded and revived their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had not yet come in scattered and fled, while Zhang Zongyu, Niu Luohong, Ren Zhu, Lai Wenguang, and others joined forces and flared up again.

sentences.zh: 論功，英翰复賜號鏗僧額巴圖魯，擢安徽布政使。

translations.literal: In reckoning merit, Ying Han was again granted the title Kengseng'e Baturu and promoted to Anhui provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: For his merits Ying Han was again granted the title Kengseng'e Baturu and promoted to Anhui provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 四年，捻匪自河南竄山東，僧格林沁戰歿，遂大舉犯安徽，覬复踞蒙、宿舊巢，英翰屯雉河集，為賊所圍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Nian bandits fled from Henan into Shandong; Sengge Rinchen died in battle; they then invaded Anhui on a large scale, aiming to reoccupy their old lairs at Mengcheng and Suzhou; Ying Han was stationed at Zhiji and was besieged by the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Nian rebels broke from Henan into Shandong. After Sengge Rinchen fell in battle they swept into Anhui, hoping to recover their old bases at Mengcheng and Suzhou. Ying Han held Zhiji and was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 道員史念祖佐英翰且戰且守，凡四十五日，援軍至，突圍夾擊，大破之，賊乃解圍引去，晉號達春巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Circuit Intendant Shi Nianzu assisted Ying Han in fighting while holding the defense for forty-five days; relief troops arrived; they broke out and attacked from both sides, heavily defeated the rebels, and the rebels then lifted the siege and withdrew; he was advanced to the title Dachun Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit Intendant Shi Nianzu helped Ying Han fight and hold the line for forty-five days until reinforcements arrived. They broke out, struck from both sides, and routed the enemy. The rebels lifted the siege and withdrew, and Ying Han was advanced to the title Dachun Baturu.

sentences.zh: 五年，就擢巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promptly promoted to governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed governor.

sentences.zh: 前撫喬松年調陝西，剿西捻張總愚，以皖軍郭寶昌從行，其餉仍由英翰籌供。

translations.literal: The former governor Qiao Songnian was transferred to Shaanxi to suppress the western Nian Zhang Zongyu; Anhui troops under Guo Baochang accompanied him, and their pay was still supplied by Ying Han.
translations.idiomatic: Former governor Qiao Songnian was sent to Shaanxi against the western Nian leader Zhang Zongyu, taking Anhui forces under Guo Baochang with him while Ying Han continued to supply their pay.

sentences.zh: 東捻由固始犯皖境，皖軍扼之，复竄麻城，英翰率軍防六安。

translations.literal: The eastern Nian entered Anhui from Gushi; Anhui troops blocked them; they again fled to Macheng; Ying Han led troops to defend Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern Nian struck Anhui from Gushi, were checked by Anhui troops, then broke toward Macheng, and Ying Han led forces to defend Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 六年，賊復由楚、豫入山東，方議就運河築長圍圈賊，英翰分撥皖軍，令黃秉鈞扼宿遷，張得勝扼貓兒窩灘，程文炳以騎兵備游擊，余承先率水師由洪湖入運河，捻勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the rebels again entered Shandong from Huguang and Henan; plans were under discussion to build a long encirclement along the Grand Canal to trap them; Ying Han divided the Anhui forces, ordered Huang Bingjun to hold Suqian, Zhang Desheng to hold Mao'erwotan, Cheng Wenbing to keep cavalry in reserve for mobile strikes, and Yu Chengxian to lead the naval force from Honghu into the canal; Nian strength gradually tightened.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the rebels again entered Shandong from Huguang and Henan while officials debated building a long canal cordon to trap them. Ying Han deployed Anhui troops with Huang Bingjun at Suqian, Zhang Desheng at Mao'erwotan, Cheng Wenbing's cavalry in reserve, and Yu Chengxian's fleet from Honghu into the canal, and the Nian position steadily narrowed.

sentences.zh: 英翰丁父憂，予假一月治喪，改署任。

translations.literal: Ying Han entered mourning for his father; he was granted one month's leave to conduct the funeral and replaced by an acting appointee.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying Han went into mourning for his father he was granted one month's leave for the funeral and an acting official took his place.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，捻首任柱為淮軍所殲，餘黨散撲運河，皖軍截擊，收降數千人，賴文光走揚州就擒。

translations.literal: That winter the Nian chief Ren Zhu was destroyed by the Huai Army; the remnant bands scattered and rushed the canal; Anhui troops intercepted them, accepted the surrender of several thousand men, and Lai Wenguang fled to Yangzhou and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Nian leader Ren Zhu was killed by the Huai Army. The remnants scattered against the canal, were cut off by Anhui troops, and several thousand surrendered; Lai Wenguang fled to Yangzhou and was taken.

sentences.zh: 東捻平，論功，予三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: When the eastern Nian were pacified, in reckoning merit he was granted the hereditary rank of third-class commandant of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: After the eastern Nian were suppressed he received the hereditary rank of third-class commandant of light chariots for his services.

sentences.zh: 再疏請終制，報可，而西捻渡河北犯。

translations.literal: He again memorialized requesting to complete mourning; approval was granted, but the western Nian crossed the Yellow River northward in invasion.
translations.idiomatic: He again asked to complete his mourning period and was granted permission, but the western Nian crossed the Yellow River and invaded the north.

sentences.zh: 七年春，畿輔戒嚴，英翰率軍馳援，命駐河南。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year the capital region was placed on alert; Ying Han led troops in urgent relief and was ordered to station in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year the capital region was placed on alert. Ying Han rushed north with his army and was ordered to hold Henan.

sentences.zh: 英翰奏以所部交河南巡撫李鶴年調遣，請回旗守制，詔慰留之。

translations.literal: Ying Han memorialized placing his troops under the command of Henan Governor Li Henian and requested to return to the banner to observe mourning; an edict comforted him and kept him in post.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Han placed his troops under Henan governor Li Henian and asked to return to his banner to complete mourning. The throne comforted him and kept him at his post.

sentences.zh: 遂會諸軍圍賊於運河東，捻眾聚殲，加太子少保，辭，不許。

translations.literal: He then joined the various armies in encircling the rebels east of the canal; the Nian masses were destroyed in a mass slaughter; he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, declined, and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined the allied armies in trapping the rebels east of the canal and destroyed the main Nian force. He was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, declined the honor, and was not allowed to refuse.

sentences.zh: 八年，回旗營葬，請留京，予假兩月，期滿仍回任。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he returned to the banner camp for burial, requested to remain in the capital, was granted two months' leave, and after it expired still returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he returned to his banner for the burial, asked to remain in the capital, was granted two months' leave, and then returned to duty when it ended.

sentences.zh: 十年，於亳州捕叛捻宋景詩，誅之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year at Bozhou he captured the rebel Nian Song Jingshi and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he captured the rebel Nian Song Jingshi at Bozhou and had him executed.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to governor-general of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed governor-general of the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 粵匪悍酋楊輔清敗逸後，猶潛匿福建晉江，令降將馬融和等往捕，至是始就擒，奏請誅之。

translations.literal: After the fierce Taiping chief Yang Fuqing was defeated and escaped, he still hid secretly in Jinjiang, Fujian; he ordered the surrendered general Ma Ronghe and others to go capture him; only then was he taken; he memorialized requesting execution.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taiping chieftain Yang Fuqing was beaten and fled, he remained hidden in Jinjiang, Fujian. Ying Han sent the surrendered general Ma Ronghe and others to capture him, and when Yang was finally taken he memorialized for his execution.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，入覲，晉二等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he had an audience at court and was advanced to second-class commandant of light chariots, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxu he had an audience at court and was advanced to hereditary second-class commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 廣東闈姓捐奉旨嚴禁，英翰奏請弛禁助餉，又因隨員招搖，為廣州將軍長善等所劾，召還京，被議，褫職。

translations.literal: The Guangdong examination surname contribution had been strictly forbidden by imperial order; Ying Han memorialized requesting relaxation of the ban to aid military funds; also because his attendants engaged in solicitation he was impeached by Guangzhou General Chang Shan and others, recalled to the capital, censured, and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: The throne had strictly forbidden Guangdong examination contributions by surname, but Ying Han asked that the ban be relaxed to raise military funds. His attendants also solicited bribes, and Guangzhou general Chang Shan and others impeached him. He was recalled to the capital, censured, and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，命還世職，以二品頂戴署烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Before long he was ordered to restore his hereditary rank and, with a second-rank hat button, acted as commander-in-chief at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered to restore his hereditary rank and appointed acting commander-in-chief at Urumqi with a second-rank hat button.

sentences.zh: 二年，實授。

translations.literal: In the second year he received formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year his appointment was made permanent.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，贈太子太保，复勇號，賜卹，諡果敏。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, his brave title was restored, mourning favors were granted, and his posthumous title was Guomin.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, his brave title was restored, mourning honors were granted, and he received the posthumous name Guomin.

sentences.zh: 安徽省城及鳳陽、壽州、宿州、阜陽、蒙城、渦陽並立專祠，賜其母銀二千兩，人葠六兩。

translations.literal: Dedicated shrines were established in the Anhui provincial capital and at Fengyang, Shouzhou, Suzhou, Fuyang, Mengcheng, and Woyang; his mother was granted two thousand taels of silver and six taels of ginseng.
translations.idiomatic: Dedicated shrines were erected in the Anhui capital and at Fengyang, Shouzhou, Suzhou, Fuyang, Mengcheng, and Woyang. His mother received two thousand taels of silver and six taels of ginseng.

sentences.zh: 無嗣，弟英壽襲世職。

translations.literal: He had no son; his younger brother Ying Shou inherited the hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: He left no son, and his younger brother Ying Shou inherited the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: =劉蓉=劉蓉，字霞仙，湖南湘鄉人。

translations.literal: Liu Rong, style name Xiaxian, was a native of Xiangxiang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rong, whose style was Xiaxian, came from Xiangxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 諸生。

translations.literal: He was a licentiate.
translations.idiomatic: He held licentiate status.

sentences.zh: 少有志節，與曾國籓、羅澤南講學。

translations.literal: In youth he had resolve and integrity and studied with Zeng Guofan and Luo Zexian.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he showed strong character and studied with Zeng Guofan and Luo Zexian.

sentences.zh: 軍事起，佐澤南治團練。

translations.literal: When military affairs arose he assisted Zexian in organizing militia.
translations.idiomatic: When war broke out he helped Zexian organize local militia.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，從國籓軍中，既克武昌，轉戰江西。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he followed Guofan's army; after Wuchang was captured he campaigned in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he joined Guofan's army, and after Wuchang fell he fought through Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 五年，澤南由江西回援湖北，蓉從之，領左營。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Zexian returned from Jiangxi to relieve Hubei; Rong followed him and commanded the Left Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Zexian marched back from Jiangxi to relieve Hubei, and Rong followed him in command of the Left Battalion.

sentences.zh: 弟蕃，戰歿於蒲圻，蓉送其喪歸，遂辭軍事。

translations.literal: His younger brother Fan died in battle at Puqi; Rong escorted the coffin home and then resigned from military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Fan was killed at Puqi. Rong escorted the body home and then left military service.

sentences.zh: 尋丁父憂，胡林翼奏徵之，不出。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he entered mourning for his father; Hu Linyi memorialized summoning him, but he did not come out.
translations.idiomatic: He soon went into mourning for his father. Hu Linyi memorialized summoning him, but he refused to return.

sentences.zh: 十一年，駱秉章督師四川，聘參軍事，疏薦其才，詔以知府加三品頂戴，署四川布政使，尋實授。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Luo Bingzhang directed armies in Sichuan, engaged him as military adviser, memorialized recommending his talent, and an edict appointed him prefect with a third-rank hat button, acting Sichuan provincial treasurer, soon followed by formal appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Luo Bingzhang commanded in Sichuan, hired him as military adviser, and recommended his ability. The throne appointed him prefect with a third-rank hat button, then acting and finally full Sichuan provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 秉章於軍事吏治，悉倚蓉贊助，亦時出視師，藍、李諸匪以次削平。

translations.literal: Bingzhang in military affairs and civil administration relied entirely on Rong's assistance; he also sometimes went out to inspect the armies, and the Lan, Li, and other bandits were successively suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: Bingzhang relied on Rong for both military and civil affairs, sometimes inspected the armies himself, and the Lan, Li, and other rebel bands were suppressed one after another.

sentences.zh: 事詳秉章傳。

translations.literal: The events are detailed in Bingzhang's biography.
translations.idiomatic: These events are recounted in full in Bingzhang's biography.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，石達開由滇、黔邊境入四川。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Shi Dakai entered Sichuan from the Yunnan-Guizhou border.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi Shi Dakai entered Sichuan from the Yunnan-Guizhou frontier.

sentences.zh: 預調諸軍羅布以待，秉章令蓉赴前敵督戰，達開不得逞，徘徊於土司地，窮蹙就擒。

translations.literal: Armies were pre-positioned in readiness; Bingzhang ordered Rong to the front to direct the fighting; Dakai could not prevail, wandered in native-official territory, was driven to extremity, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Troops were deployed in advance. Bingzhang sent Rong to the front to direct operations. Dakai could not break through, wandered among the native chieftaincies, was cornered, and captured.

sentences.zh: 蓉親往受俘，檻送成都誅之，被旨嘉獎。

translations.literal: Rong went in person to receive the prisoner, sent him in a cage to Chengdu for execution, and received an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Rong went in person to take the prisoner, sent him in a cage to Chengdu for execution, and received an imperial commendation.

sentences.zh: 時粵、捻諸匪藍成春、陳得才等竄擾陝南，踞漢中、城固等城，川匪餘孽亦入陝蔓延，勢方熾。

translations.literal: At the time Taiping and Nian rebels Lan Chengcun, Chen Decai, and others raided southern Shaanxi, occupied Hanzhong, Chenggu, and other cities, and remnants of Sichuan bandits also entered Shaanxi and spread; their power was then at its height.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping and Nian forces under Lan Chengcun, Chen Decai, and others were raiding southern Shaanxi and holding Hanzhong, Chenggu, and other towns, while Sichuan rebel remnants spread into Shaanxi and the threat was at its peak.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿督師關中，注重北路回匪，於南路未能兼顧。

translations.literal: Duolong'a directed armies in Guanzhong, focused on the northern-route Hui rebels, and could not attend to the southern route as well.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a commanded in Guanzhong, concentrating on Hui rebels in the north and unable to cover the southern front as well.

sentences.zh: 官文疏薦蓉堪當一面，於是命蓉督辦陝南軍務，擢陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Guan Wen memorialized recommending Rong as fit to hold an independent command; he was then ordered to supervise military affairs in southern Shaanxi and promoted to governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen recommended Rong as fit for independent command. He was ordered to supervise southern Shaanxi military affairs and promoted to governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 秉章分兵四千授蓉，總兵蕭慶高、何勝必兩軍先赴援，亦隸之。

translations.literal: Bingzhang divided four thousand troops and gave them to Rong; Brigadiers Xiao Qinggao and He Shengbi with their two armies went first to relieve the front and also came under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Bingzhang gave Rong four thousand men. Brigadiers Xiao Qinggao and He Shengbi marched ahead with their armies and also came under his command.

sentences.zh: 又遣將赴湖南增募萬人，蓉於十月進屯廣元。

translations.literal: He also sent officers to Hunan to raise another ten thousand men; in the tenth month Rong advanced and encamped at Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent officers to Hunan to raise another ten thousand troops, and in the tenth month Rong advanced and encamped at Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 三年春，漢中粵、捻諸匪因江寧被圍急，促其回援，遂自退，趨湖北。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year the Taiping and Nian rebels in Hanzhong, because Jiangning was urgently besieged, were pressed to return in relief, and therefore withdrew on their own toward Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year the Taiping and Nian forces in Hanzhong, pressed to return and relieve the siege of Jiangning, withdrew on their own toward Hubei.

sentences.zh: 蓉入漢中部署屯防，清餘匪。

translations.literal: Rong entered Hanzhong, deployed garrisons, and cleared out remnant bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Rong entered Hanzhong, deployed garrisons, and cleared out the remaining bandits.

sentences.zh: 多隆阿圍盩厔久未下，聞蓉將至，督攻益急，克之，而多隆阿受重傷。

translations.literal: Duolong'a besieged Zhouzhi for a long time without taking it; hearing that Rong was coming, he pressed the assault more urgently, captured it, and Duolong'a received serious wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Duolong'a had besieged Zhouzhi for a long time without success. Hearing Rong was coming, he pressed the assault harder, took the city, and was himself seriously wounded.

sentences.zh: 三月，蓉抵省城，多隆阿尋卒於軍，其所部雷正綰、陶茂林諸軍剿西路回匪，入甘肅；

translations.literal: In the third month Rong reached the provincial capital; Duolong'a soon died in the army; his subordinates Lei Zhengwan, Tao Maolin, and other armies suppressed western-route Hui rebels and entered Gansu;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Rong reached the provincial capital. Duolong'a soon died in camp, while his subordinates Lei Zhengwan and Tao Maolin took their forces against western Hui rebels into Gansu;

sentences.zh: 穆圖善一軍議令赴援湖北。

translations.literal: Mutushan's army was under discussion to be sent to relieve Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Mutushan's army was under discussion for dispatch to relieve Hubei.

sentences.zh: 五月，川匪合粵、捻由鎮安、孝義突犯省城，蓉集諸軍擊之於鄠、盩厔之間，尋偕穆圖善會擊於郿縣，賊西走略陽，入甘肅，陷階州，令何勝必等會川軍周達武攻之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Sichuan bandits together with Taiping and Nian rebels suddenly attacked the provincial capital from Zhen'an and Xiaoyi; Rong gathered the armies and struck them between Hu and Zhouzhi; soon he joined Mutushan in a joint attack at Mei County; the rebels fled west to Lueyang, entered Gansu, captured Jiezhou, and he ordered He Shengbi and others to join Sichuan forces under Zhou Dawu in attacking it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Sichuan bandits and Taiping-Nian forces suddenly struck the provincial capital from Zhen'an and Xiaoyi. Rong gathered his armies and hit them between Hu and Zhouzhi, then joined Mutushan at Mei County. The rebels fled west through Lueyang into Gansu and took Jiezhou, and he ordered He Shengbi and others to join Zhou Dawu's Sichuan force against them.

sentences.zh: 四年，克階州，川匪餘孽悉平。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Jiezhou was captured and the remnant Sichuan bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Jiezhou was taken and the last Sichuan rebel remnants were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 雷正綰軍譁變，其部將胡士貴率叛兵回擾涇州，蓉遣軍扼隘，散其脅從，誅士貴。

translations.literal: Lei Zhengwan's army mutinied; his subordinate Hu Shigui led rebel troops back to harass Jingzhou; Rong sent troops to hold the passes, dispersed their coerced followers, and executed Shigui.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Zhengwan's army mutinied. His officer Hu Shigui led rebel troops back to raid Jingzhou. Rong sent troops to hold the passes, broke up their forced followers, and executed Shigui.

sentences.zh: 會編修蔡壽祺疏劾恭親王奕訢，牽及蓉，指為夤緣，詔詰蓉令自陳。

translations.literal: At the same time Compiler Cai Shouqi memorialized impeaching Prince Gong Yixin and implicated Rong, alleging patronage connections; an edict questioned Rong and ordered him to explain himself.
translations.idiomatic: Compiler Cai Shouqi then impeached Prince Gong Yixin and implicated Rong as a patronage ally. The throne questioned Rong and ordered a personal explanation.

sentences.zh: 蓉奏辦，自言薦舉本末，並訐壽祺前在四川招搖，擅募兵勇，為蓉所阻，挾嫌構陷。

translations.literal: Rong memorialized in reply, stating the full course of the recommendation himself, and also accused Shouqi of earlier in Sichuan engaging in solicitation and privately recruiting braves, which Rong had blocked, and that he bore a grudge and framed him.
translations.idiomatic: Rong replied in a memorial, explaining how the recommendation had come about and accusing Shouqi of earlier solicitation and unauthorized recruitment in Sichuan, which Rong had blocked, and of framing him out of resentment.

sentences.zh: 復為內閣侍讀學士陳廷經所劾，命大學士瑞常、尚書羅惇衍按究，坐漏洩密摺，降調革任。

translations.literal: He was again impeached by Hanlin Reader Chen Tingjing; Grand Secretary Ruichang and Minister Luo Dunyan were ordered to investigate; he was found guilty of leaking secret memorials, demoted, transferred, and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tingjing of the Hanlin impeached him again. Grand Secretary Ruichang and Minister Luo Dunyan were sent to investigate. He was found guilty of leaking secret memorials, demoted, transferred, and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 陝甘總督楊岳斌疏言陝西士民為訴枉乞留，詔蓉仍署巡撫。

translations.literal: Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Yang Yuebin memorialized that Shaanxi gentry and commoners pleaded that he had been wronged and begged him to remain; an edict ordered Rong to continue acting as governor.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Yang Yuebin reported that Shaanxi gentry and commoners pleaded Rong had been wronged and asked him to stay. The throne ordered Rong to continue as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 五年，奏薦賢能牧令龔衡齡等，請予升階，下部議駮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he memorialized recommending able magistrates such as Gong Hengling and requested advancement in rank for them; the ministry deliberated and rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he recommended able magistrates such as Gong Hengling for promotion, but the ministry deliberated and rejected the request.

sentences.zh: 蓉疏言：「近來登進之途，多出於從軍，而究心民瘼者，仍潦倒於下吏。

translations.literal: Rong memorialized: "Recently the path of advancement has mostly come through military service, while those who truly attend to the people's hardships still languish in lower offices."
translations.idiomatic: Rong wrote: "Advancement lately comes chiefly through military service, while officials who truly care for the people's hardships still languish in low posts."

sentences.zh: 陝西瘡痍未起，急應旌舉賢能以為之勸。

translations.literal: Shaanxi's wounds have not yet healed; it is urgent to commend able men as encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi has not yet recovered from its wounds, and able officials should be commended at once as encouragement.

sentences.zh: 」上特允之。

translations.literal: " The emperor specially approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor specially granted his request.

sentences.zh: 先是，蓉任鳳邠道黃輔辰經理回民叛產，設法墾治，歲獲穀數百萬斛，成效甚著，因奏：「陝西兵後荒蕪，以招徠開墾為急務。

translations.literal: Earlier Rong had put Feng-Bin Circuit Intendant Huang Fuchen in charge of managing rebel Hui property, devised methods of reclamation, and obtained several million hu of grain yearly with very marked results; he therefore memorialized: "After the wars Shaanxi lies waste; attracting settlers and opening land for cultivation is the urgent task."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Rong had put Huang Fuchen in charge of rebel Hui estates in the Feng-Bin circuit, organized reclamation, and harvested several million hu of grain a year with striking results. He memorialized: "After the wars Shaanxi lies in ruins; attracting settlers and opening land is the urgent task."

sentences.zh: 應視兵災輕重，荒地多少，以招墾成數為州官吏勸懲。

translations.literal: Rewards and punishments for prefectural officials should be based on the severity of military disaster, the amount of wasteland, and the results of attracting reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials should be rewarded or punished according to the severity of war damage, the extent of wasteland, and how much land they brought under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was reported.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 尋以病乞開缺，上允其請，以喬松年代之，仍留陝西治軍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, on account of illness he requested to vacate his post; the emperor granted his request; Qiao Songnian replaced him but remained in Shaanxi to manage the armies.
translations.idiomatic: He soon asked to resign on account of illness, and the emperor agreed. Qiao Songnian replaced him but remained in Shaanxi to command the armies.

sentences.zh: 捻匪張總愚入陝，逼省城，蓉與松年議不合，所部楚軍三十營，統將無專主，士無戰心，屯灞橋，為賊所乘，大潰。

translations.literal: Nian bandit Zhang Zongyu entered Shaanxi and pressed the provincial capital; Rong and Songnian could not agree; his thirty battalions of Chu troops had no dedicated commander, the soldiers lacked fighting spirit, were encamped at Baqiao, were taken advantage of by the rebels, and suffered a great rout.
translations.idiomatic: Nian leader Zhang Zongyu entered Shaanxi and threatened the provincial capital. Rong and Songnian could not agree. His thirty battalions of Hunan troops had no single commander, the men lacked fighting spirit, and while encamped at Baqiao they were overrun and routed.

sentences.zh: 詔斥蓉貽誤，奪職回籍。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked Rong for causing harm, stripped him of office, and sent him back to his native place.
translations.idiomatic: An edict blamed Rong for the disaster, stripped him of office, and sent him home.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year.

sentences.zh: 湖南巡撫王文韶疏聞，命复官，陝西請祀名宦祠。

translations.literal: Hunan Governor Wang Wenshao memorialized reporting his death; he was ordered restored to office posthumously; Shaanxi requested sacrifice in the shrine of eminent officials.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan governor Wang Wenshao reported his death. The throne posthumously restored his rank, and Shaanxi asked that he be honored in the shrine of eminent officials.

sentences.zh: =喬松年=喬松年，字鶴儕，山西徐溝人。

translations.literal: Qiao Songnian, style name Hechai, was a native of Xugou in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Songnian, whose style was Hechai, came from Xugou in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 道光十五年進士，授工部主事，再遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Works, and was later transferred to director.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the fifteenth year of Daoguang, entered the Ministry of Works as a secretary, and was later promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，以知府發江蘇，除松江，調蘇州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he was dispatched to Jiangsu as prefect, appointed to Songjiang, and transferred to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng he was sent to Jiangsu as prefect, took Songjiang, and was moved to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 會匪劉麗川據上海，省城潮勇潛與通，松年偵知之，白上官誅其為首者。

translations.literal: When the Small Sword Society rebel Liu Lichuan held Shanghai, Chaozhou braves in the provincial capital secretly communicated with him; Songnian detected it and reported to superiors, who executed the ringleaders.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Lichuan of the Small Sword Society held Shanghai, Chaozhou braves in the provincial capital were secretly in contact with him. Songnian uncovered the plot and reported it; the ringleaders were executed.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，總督怡良奏留，從克上海，擢道員，賜花翎，授常鎮通海道。

translations.literal: When he entered mourning for his father, Governor Yiliang memorialized to retain him; he followed in the capture of Shanghai, was promoted to circuit intendant, granted the peacock feather, and appointed to the Chang-Zhen-Tonghai Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When he went into mourning for his father, governor Yiliang asked that he be kept in service. He took part in recovering Shanghai, was promoted to circuit intendant, granted the peacock feather, and appointed to the Chang-Zhen-Tonghai circuit.

sentences.zh: 六年，從怡良駐常州，署兩淮鹽運使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Yiliang in stationing at Changzhou and acted as Liang-Huai salt controller.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Yiliang to Changzhou and served as acting Liang-Huai salt controller.

sentences.zh: 八年，丁本生父憂，總督何桂清復奏留。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he entered mourning for his biological father; Governor He Guiqing again memorialized to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he mourned his biological father, and governor He Guiqing again asked that he remain in service.

sentences.zh: 九年，授兩淮鹽運使，兼辦江北糧台。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Liang-Huai salt controller and also managed the northern Jiangsu grain depot.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Liang-Huai salt controller and also took charge of the northern Jiangsu grain depot.

sentences.zh: 十年，奏劾南河河道總督庚長擅提淮北存鹽變價充餉，又截留山西解江北糧台餉銀；

translations.literal: In the tenth year he memorialized impeaching South River director-general Geng Chang for arbitrarily drawing on stored salt north of the Huai, selling it for funds, and also intercepting Shanxi silver dispatched to the northern Jiangsu grain depot;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he impeached South River director-general Geng Chang for seizing stored salt north of the Huai, selling it for military funds, and intercepting Shanxi silver meant for the northern Jiangsu grain depot;

sentences.zh: 复劾庚長在清江聞警猶演劇設宴，迨寇急，倉皇退守。

translations.literal: He again impeached Geng Chang for at Qingjiang, on hearing the alarm, still putting on plays and holding banquets, and when the enemy pressed urgently, retreating in panic to defend.
translations.idiomatic: He also accused Geng Chang of staging plays and banquets at Qingjiang after the alarm was raised, then fleeing in panic when the enemy pressed close.

sentences.zh: 命侍郎文俊往按得實，庚長褫職逮問。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Wen Jun was ordered to investigate; the facts were established; Geng Chang was stripped of office and arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Wen Jun was sent to investigate, confirmed the charges, and Geng Chang was dismissed and arrested.

sentences.zh: 又疏論用勇不如用兵，請發京師護軍營暨北五省綠營赴江北防剿。

translations.literal: He also memorialized arguing that using braves was inferior to using regular troops, and requested dispatch of the capital guard battalion and Green Standard forces of the five northern provinces to northern Jiangsu for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that militia were inferior to regular troops and asked that the capital guard battalion and Green Standard forces from the five northern provinces be sent to northern Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 英吉利、法蘭西兵入犯，京師戒嚴，松年請赴畿輔督兵禦敵，諭止之。

translations.literal: When English and French troops invaded, the capital was placed on alert; Songnian requested to go to the capital region to direct troops against the enemy; he was ordered to stop.
translations.idiomatic: When British and French forces invaded and the capital was placed on alert, Songnian asked to command troops in the capital region, but the throne ordered him to remain.

sentences.zh: 十一年，設江南北兩糧台，仍命松年辦理。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the two grain depots of Jiangnan north and south were established, and Songnian was still ordered to manage them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the two Jiangnan grain depots were established, and Songnian was again put in charge.

sentences.zh: 敘勞，以按察使記名。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he was noted for provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His services were recognized and he was noted for promotion to provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，擢江寧布政使，仍留辦糧台，擢安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he was promoted to Jiangning provincial treasurer, still retained to manage the grain depot, and promoted to governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi he became Jiangning provincial treasurer while keeping charge of the grain depot, then was promoted to governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 三年，抵任，駐防臨淮。

translations.literal: In the third year he reached his post and was stationed on defense at Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he took up his post and made his headquarters at Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 時苗匪已平，李世忠亦解兵柄，捻匪竄河南、湖北。

translations.literal: At the time the Miao bandits had been pacified, Li Shizhong had also relinquished military command, and Nian bandits fled into Henan and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Miao rebels had been suppressed, Li Shizhong had given up military command, and Nian forces were breaking into Henan and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 松年增募勇千人，就潁、宿間設防，奏請雉河集地處交衝，當建縣設官，從之。

translations.literal: Songnian raised another thousand braves and set defenses between Ying and Su; he memorialized that Zhiji lay at a strategic crossroads and should have a county established with officials; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Songnian raised another thousand militiamen and posted defenses between Ying and Su. He memorialized that Zhiji, a strategic crossroads, should be made a county with regular officials, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 又奏苗沛霖餘黨自非積惡，請予寬貸；

translations.literal: He also memorialized that Miao Peilin's remnant followers were not themselves deeply guilty and requested leniency;
translations.idiomatic: He also asked leniency for Miao Peilin's followers, arguing they were not deeply guilty themselves;

sentences.zh: 李世忠散遣勇丁，恐流為盜，飭州縣整頓捕務。

translations.literal: Li Shizhong was disbanding braves, and fearing they would become bandits, he ordered prefectures and counties to tighten arrest duties.
translations.idiomatic: As Li Shizhong disbanded his braves, fearing they would turn to banditry, he ordered prefectures and counties to tighten policing.

sentences.zh: 粵、捻諸匪自湖北麻城、羅田東竄入皖境，松年移軍壽州，急調英翰自湖北迴援，令硃淮森屯正陽關，蔣凝學迎擊於英山，克金家寨。

translations.literal: Taiping and Nian rebels fled east from Macheng and Luotian in Hubei into Anhui; Songnian moved his army to Shouzhou, urgently recalled Ying Han from Hubei, ordered Zhu Huaisen to garrison Zhengyangguan, and Jiang Ningxue to meet the attack at Yingshan and capture Jinjiazhai.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping and Nian forces broke east from Macheng and Luotian in Hubei into Anhui. Songnian moved to Shouzhou, urgently recalled Ying Han from Hubei, posted Zhu Huaisen at Zhengyangguan, and had Jiang Ningxue meet the enemy at Yingshan and take Jinjiazhai.

sentences.zh: 英翰等敗賊於陶家河、黑石渡，僧格林沁大軍追至合擊，諸賊窮蹙，紛紛乞降，先後凡十餘萬。

translations.literal: Ying Han and others defeated the rebels at Taojiahe and Heishidu; Sengge Rinchen's main army pursued and joined in the attack; the rebels were driven to extremity and begged to surrender one after another, totaling more than a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Han and others defeated the rebels at Taojiahe and Heishidu. Sengge Rinchen's main force came up and joined the attack. Cornered, the rebels surrendered in waves totaling more than a hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 賊首陳得才後至，為蔣凝學擊敗，服毒死，獲其屍。

translations.literal: The rebel chief Chen Decai arrived later, was defeated by Jiang Ningxue, took poison and died, and his corpse was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel chief Chen Decai arrived later, was beaten by Jiang Ningxue, took poison and died, and his body was recovered.

sentences.zh: 上飭英翰等移軍進剿，松年請留英翰防皖境，郭寶昌援河南，蔣凝學赴湖北。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ying Han and others to move the army forward in suppression; Songnian requested that Ying Han remain to defend Anhui, Guo Baochang relieve Henan, and Jiang Ningxue go to Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: The throne ordered Ying Han and others to advance in pursuit. Songnian asked that Ying Han stay to defend Anhui, Guo Baochang reinforce Henan, and Jiang Ningxue go to Hubei.

sentences.zh: 四年，僧格林沁戰歿，上命曾國籓督師山東。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Sengge Rinchen died in battle; the emperor ordered Zeng Guofan to direct armies in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Sengge Rinchen fell in battle, and the throne ordered Zeng Guofan to command in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 松年奏：「國籓久治軍務，氣體較遜於前。

translations.literal: Songnian memorialized: "Guofan has long managed military affairs, but his physical vigor is rather less than before."
translations.idiomatic: Songnian wrote: "Guofan has commanded armies for many years, but his health is no longer what it was."

sentences.zh: 李鴻章才識亞於國籓，而年力正強，如以代國籓督師山東，必能迅奏蕩平。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang's talent is somewhat below Guofan's, but his years and strength are at their prime; if he were substituted for Guofan in commanding Shandong, he would surely quickly report complete pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang is somewhat less able than Guofan, but he is in his prime. If he replaced Guofan in Shandong, he would surely bring the campaign to a swift end.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，報聞。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted and merely noted.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was received and merely noted.

sentences.zh: 時捻匪大舉犯皖北，圍英翰於雉河集，國籓遣援軍至，乃擊走之。

translations.literal: At the time Nian bandits invaded northern Anhui on a large scale and besieged Ying Han at Zhiji; Guofan sent relief troops, and they were then driven off.
translations.idiomatic: Nian rebels then swept into northern Anhui and besieged Ying Han at Zhiji until Guofan sent reinforcements and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 五年，調陝西巡撫，前任巡撫劉蓉奉命留陝辦理軍務。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to governor of Shaanxi; the former governor Liu Rong was ordered to remain in Shaanxi to manage military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made governor of Shaanxi while former governor Liu Rong was ordered to remain there to handle military affairs.

sentences.zh: 時捻匪張總愚竄入陝境，松年初至，與蓉意見不合，奏劾蓉軍政隳壞，留陝無益，蓉亦劾松年掣肘，貪利徇私。

translations.literal: At the time Nian bandit Zhang Zongyu fled into Shaanxi; Songnian had just arrived; he and Rong could not agree; he memorialized impeaching Rong for ruined military administration and that remaining in Shaanxi was useless; Rong also impeached Songnian for obstruction, greed for profit, and favoritism.
