translations.idiomatic: Nian leader Zhang Zongyu had entered Shaanxi. Songnian had just arrived and clashed with Rong. He impeached Rong for ruining military affairs and said keeping him in Shaanxi was useless. Rong impeached Songnian in turn for obstruction, greed, and favoritism.

sentences.zh: 十二月，賊逼省城，蓉軍潰於灞橋。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the rebels pressed the provincial capital; Rong's army was routed at Baqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the rebels threatened the provincial capital and Rong's army was routed at Baqiao.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，提督劉松山援軍至，破賊雨花寨，連戰皆捷，省城始安。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year Provincial Military Commissioner Liu Songshan's relief army arrived, broke the rebels at Yuhuazhai, won successive battles, and the provincial capital was then secured.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year Liu Songshan's relief force arrived, took Yuhuazhai, won battle after battle, and the provincial capital was finally secured.

sentences.zh: 迭奏請師，鮑超軍援陝迄不至，皖軍郭寶昌應調來援，偕劉松山轉戰涇、渭之間，屢捷。

translations.literal: He repeatedly memorialized requesting troops; Bao Chao's army for relief in Shaanxi never arrived; Anhui troops under Guo Baochang came as ordered; together with Liu Songshan they campaigned between the Jing and Wei rivers and won repeated victories.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly asked for reinforcements, but Bao Chao's promised relief never came. Anhui forces under Guo Baochang answered the call and, with Liu Songshan, fought between the Jing and Wei rivers with repeated success.

sentences.zh: 總愚窺同州，欲渡河，未得逞，趨陝北。

translations.literal: Zongyu watched Tongzhou, wished to cross the river, could not succeed, and turned toward northern Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyu probed Tongzhou and tried to cross the river, failed, and turned north into Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 六月，總督左宗棠至陝，軍事始有統轄。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Governor-General Zuo Zongtang reached Shaanxi and military affairs finally had unified command.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Zuo Zongtang arrived in Shaanxi, and the armies finally came under unified command.

sentences.zh: 松山、寶昌等連破賊於北路，至冬，總愚由垣曲渡河，循太行東趨，松山、寶昌尾追。

translations.literal: Songshan, Baochang, and others repeatedly defeated the rebels on the northern route; by winter Zongyu crossed the river from Yuanqu and marched east along the Taihang; Songshan and Baochang pursued from behind.
translations.idiomatic: Songshan and Baochang won repeated victories in the north. That winter Zongyu crossed at Yuanqu and marched east along the Taihang range, with Songshan and Baochang in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 七年春，宗棠率師入衛畿輔，陝西自捻匪出境，西路回氛仍未靖，松年以病乞假歸。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year Zongtang led troops to guard the capital region; after the Nian left Shaanxi, unrest among western-route Hui was still not pacified; Songnian requested leave on account of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the seventh year Zongtang marched to defend the capital region. The Nian had left Shaanxi, but western Hui unrest was still unsettled, and Songnian went home on sick leave.

sentences.zh: 九年，病痊，授倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when his illness healed, he was appointed vice minister of the granary administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, after he recovered, he was appointed vice minister of the granary administration.

sentences.zh: 十年，授河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed director-general of the Hedong River administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed director-general of the Hedong River works.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「今日言治河，不外兩策：一則堵銅瓦廂決口，復歸清江浦故道；

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In discussing river control today there are no more than two policies: one is to block the breach at Tongwaxiang and restore the old course to Qingjiangpu;"
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "River control today comes down to two policies: block the breach at Tongwaxiang and restore the old route to Qingjiangpu;"

sentences.zh: 一則就黃水現到處築堤束之，俾不至橫流，至利津入海。

translations.literal: the other is to build dikes wherever the Yellow River presently reaches to confine it so that it does not spread sideways until it enters the sea at Lijin.
translations.idiomatic: or build dikes along the Yellow River's present course to confine it, keep it from spreading, and send it to the sea at Lijin.

sentences.zh: 權衡輕重，以就東境築堤束黃為順水之性，事半功倍。

translations.literal: Weighing the relative merits, building dikes in the eastern region to confine the Yellow River accords with the nature of the water and achieves twice the result with half the effort.
translations.idiomatic: Weighing the options, confining the Yellow River with dikes in the east follows the river's nature and would achieve far more with far less effort.

sentences.zh: 前數年大溜全趨張秋，後又決胡堰、洪川口、霍家橋、新興屯諸地，黃流穿運，節節梗阻。

translations.literal: In previous years the main current entirely turned toward Zhangqiu; later it breached again at Huyan, Hongchuankou, Huojiaqiao, Xinxingtun, and other places; the Yellow current cut through the canal, creating obstruction at every stage.
translations.idiomatic: In earlier years the main current had run entirely toward Zhangqiu, then broke out again at Huyan, Hongchuankou, Huojiaqiao, Xinxingtun, and elsewhere. The Yellow River cut through the canal and blocked it section by section.

sentences.zh: 惟有盡堵旁洩之路，自張秋西南，沙河迤北，就舊堤修補，為黃河北堤；

translations.literal: the only course is to block all side outlets completely; from southwest of Zhangqiu northward along the Sha River, repair the old dikes to form the north dike of the Yellow River;
translations.idiomatic: The only course is to seal every side outlet: from southwest of Zhangqiu north along the Sha River, repair the old dikes as the Yellow River's north bank;

sentences.zh: 又自張志門起，至沈家口、馬山頭，築新堤一百八十餘裡，為黃河南堤：俾仍全趨張秋，藉以濟運。

translations.literal: and from Zhangzhimen to Shenjiakou and Mashantou build a new dike of more than one hundred and eighty li as the south dike of the Yellow River, so that the current may still run entirely toward Zhangqiu and thereby aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: and from Zhangzhimen to Shenjiakou and Mashantou build more than one hundred and eighty li of new south bank so the current still runs to Zhangqiu and keeps the canal supplied.

sentences.zh: 」下廷臣議行。

translations.literal: " It was referred to court ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was sent to the court for deliberation and implementation.

sentences.zh: 十三年，奏請裁東河總督，以巡撫兼領河工，下部議，格不行。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he memorialized requesting abolition of the East River governor-general and having the provincial governor also oversee river works; the ministry deliberated and the proposal was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he asked to abolish the East River governor-general post and let the provincial governor oversee river works as well. The ministry deliberated and rejected the plan.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，卒，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he died; his posthumous title was Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Guangxu and received the posthumous name Qinke.

sentences.zh: =錢鼎銘=錢鼎銘，字調甫，江蘇太倉人。

translations.literal: Qian Dingming, style name Diaofu, was a native of Taicang in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Dingming, whose style was Diaofu, came from Taicang in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 父寶琛，湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: His father Baoqin was governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: His father Baoqin had been governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 鼎銘，道光二十六年舉人，從寶琛治團練。

translations.literal: Dingming became a provincial graduate in the twenty-sixth year of Daoguang and followed Baoqin in organizing militia.
translations.idiomatic: Dingming became a provincial graduate in the twenty-sixth year of Daoguang and helped Baoqin organize local militia.

sentences.zh: 會匪劉麗川據上海，青浦周立春起應之，陷嘉定，鼎銘與嘉定舉人吳林募勇從官軍復其城，授贛榆訓導。

translations.literal: When the Small Sword Society rebel Liu Lichuan held Shanghai, Zhou Lichun of Qingpu rose in response, and Jiading fell; Dingming together with the Jiading graduate Wu Lin raised braves and followed the official army in recovering the city; he was appointed director of studies in Ganyu.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Lichuan of the Small Sword Society held Shanghai, Zhou Lichun of Qingpu rose in support and Jiading fell. Dingming and the Jiading graduate Wu Lin raised militia, joined the official army in recovering the city, and he was appointed director of studies in Ganyu.

sentences.zh: 入貲為戶部主事，丁父憂歸。

translations.literal: He purchased office as a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and returned home on entering mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased a post as a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue, then went home to mourn his father.

sentences.zh: 江南大營再潰，諸郡縣淪陷，巡撫薛煥退保上海一隅。

translations.literal: The Jiangnan Grand Camp collapsed again, prefectures and counties fell, and Governor Xue Huan retreated to defend only the corner of Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Grand Camp collapsed again, prefecture after prefecture fell, and governor Xue Huan retreated to hold only Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓既克安慶，團練大臣龐鍾璐等議乞援，道路梗阻。

translations.literal: After Zeng Guofan had captured Anqing, militia commissioner Pang Zhonglu and others discussed begging for relief, but the roads were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: After Zeng Guofan took Anqing, militia commissioner Pang Zhonglu and others wanted to ask for help, but the roads were blocked.

sentences.zh: 鼎銘奮然請行，乘洋商輪船溯江上，至安慶謁國籓，陳吳中百姓阽危，上海中外互市，榷稅所入，足運兵數万，不宜棄之資賊。

translations.literal: Dingming boldly volunteered to go, took a foreign merchant steamer up the river, reached Anqing and visited Guofan, and stated that the people of central Wu were on the brink of ruin, that Shanghai was a Sino-foreign trading port whose customs revenue could supply tens of thousands of troops, and that it should not be abandoned to aid the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Dingming volunteered boldly, took a foreign steamer upriver to Anqing, and told Guofan that the people of central Wu were near ruin. Shanghai was a treaty port whose customs revenue could supply tens of thousands of troops and must not be abandoned to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 策畫數千言，繼以痛哭，國籓遂決策濟師。

translations.literal: He laid out a plan of several thousand words and then wept bitterly; Guofan thereupon decided to send relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: He laid out a plan thousands of words long and then wept. Guofan decided on the spot to send relief.

sentences.zh: 時薛煥遣將至湖南募勇萬二千，國籓知所募皆各軍汰遺，不可用，令鼎銘往解散。

translations.literal: At the time Xue Huan had sent officers to Hunan to raise twelve thousand braves; Guofan knew those recruited were cast-offs from various armies and unusable, and ordered Dingming to go and disband them.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Huan had sent officers to Hunan to raise twelve thousand men, but Guofan knew they were cast-offs from other armies and unusable. He sent Dingming to disband them.

sentences.zh: 遇諸漢口，鼎銘簡留精壯九百人，餘悉罷歸，無譁者。

translations.literal: He met them at Hankou; Dingming selected and kept nine hundred picked strong men and dismissed the rest, without disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: He met them at Hankou, kept nine hundred of the best men, sent the rest home without incident.

sentences.zh: 還上海，籌餉十八萬，租船五，复率赴安慶迎師。

translations.literal: Returning to Shanghai, he raised one hundred and eighty thousand taels in funds, chartered five boats, and again led them to Anqing to welcome the army.
translations.idiomatic: Back in Shanghai he raised one hundred and eighty thousand taels, chartered five boats, and led the force to Anqing to meet the army.

sentences.zh: 於是國籓奏令延建邵道李鴻章率淮勇五千人赴之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Guofan memorialized ordering Yanjian-Shaodao Circuit Intendant Li Hongzhang to lead five thousand Huai braves there.
translations.idiomatic: Guofan then memorialized for Li Hongzhang of the Yanjian-Shaodao circuit to lead five thousand Huai troops there.

sentences.zh: 同治元年三月，至上海，鴻章尋署江蘇巡撫，奏請以鼎銘參軍事，多所贊畫。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Tongzhi they reached Shanghai; Hongzhang soon acted as governor of Jiangsu and memorialized requesting Dingming as military adviser, with much planning assistance.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Tongzhi they reached Shanghai. Hongzhang soon became acting governor of Jiangsu and had Dingming serve as military adviser, contributing much to planning.

sentences.zh: 積功，擢道員，賜花翎，加布政使銜。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit he was promoted to circuit intendant, granted the peacock feather, and given the rank of provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: For his services he was promoted to circuit intendant, granted the peacock feather, and given provincial treasurer rank.

sentences.zh: 五年，鴻章代國籓督師剿捻匪，令鼎銘駐清江浦，主轉運糧餉軍仗，迄捻匪滅，始終無絀誤。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Hongzhang replaced Guofan in commanding armies against the Nian and ordered Dingming stationed at Qingjiangpu to manage transport of grain, funds, and military stores; until the Nian were destroyed there was never a shortfall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Hongzhang replaced Guofan in command against the Nian and posted Dingming at Qingjiangpu to manage supplies. Until the Nian were destroyed he never once failed.

sentences.zh: 鴻章與漕運總督張之萬累疏薦。

translations.literal: Hongzhang and grain-transport director-general Zhang Zhiwan repeatedly memorialized recommending him.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhang and grain-transport director-general Zhang Zhiwan repeatedly recommended him.

sentences.zh: 國籓移督直隸，奏調以從。

translations.literal: When Guofan moved to govern Zhili he memorialized transferring Dingming to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: When Guofan moved to Zhili he had Dingming transferred to follow him.

sentences.zh: 八年，授大順廣道，就遷按察使，又遷布政使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed to the Da-Shun-Guang Circuit, promptly moved to provincial judicial commissioner, and then to provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed to the Da-Shun-Guang circuit, then promptly made provincial judicial commissioner and provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was made governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，捻匪餘孽蠢動，鼎銘令總兵崔廷桂剿平之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year remnant Nian bandits stirred; Dingming ordered Brigadier Cui Tinggui to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year remnant Nian forces stirred again, and Dingming sent Brigadier Cui Tinggui to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 用直隸練軍制，就河南三鎮額兵，簡其精壯，抽練馬步各三營，重其額餉，擇駐衝要地訓練，期年成軍。

translations.literal: He adopted the Zhili trained-army system, took the quota troops of Henan's three garrisons, selected the strong, drew off three battalions each of horse and foot for training, increased their pay allotments, chose strategic posts for training, and within a year formed an army.
translations.idiomatic: He adopted the Zhili trained-army model, drew on Henan's three garrison quotas, picked the strongest men, formed three horse and three foot battalions, increased their pay, trained them at key posts, and had a usable force within a year.

sentences.zh: 修水利，鑿賈魯河故道，南自周家口，北至硃仙鎮，又西北至鄭州京水寨，疏積沙，補殘堤，俾上游無水澇，下游通舟楫。

translations.literal: He repaired waterworks, reopened the old course of the Jialu River from Zhoujiakou in the south to Zhuxianzhen in the north and then northwest to Jingshuizhai in Zhengzhou, dredged accumulated sand, repaired broken dikes, so that the upper reaches had no flood and the lower reaches were open to boats.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired waterworks and reopened the old Jialu River channel from Zhoujiakou south to Zhuxianzhen north and on to Jingshuizhai near Zhengzhou, dredged silt, repaired broken dikes, ended flooding upstream, and restored navigation downstream.

sentences.zh: 复濬勺金河、丈八溝、餘濟河、永豐渠以資灌溉。

translations.literal: He also dredged the Shaojin River, Zhangbagou, Yuji River, and Yongfeng Canal to supply irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: He also dredged the Shaojin River, Zhangbagou, Yuji River, and Yongfeng Canal for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 令諸州縣勸民按畝出穀，就鄉分倉，擇公正紳耆董其事，毋假手胥吏，通省積穀九十餘萬石。

translations.literal: He ordered prefectures and counties to urge the people to contribute grain by the mu, establish local granaries by township, choose upright gentry elders to manage the matter without handing it to clerks, and accumulated more than nine hundred thousand shi of grain in the whole province.
translations.idiomatic: He had prefectures and counties urge farmers to contribute grain by the mu, set up local granaries, put upright gentry in charge without using clerks, and built a provincial reserve of more than nine hundred thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 提督張曜一軍出關剿回，全軍餉由河南供給無缺。

translations.literal: Provincial Military Commissioner Zhang Yao led an army beyond the passes to suppress the Hui; the entire army's pay was supplied by Henan without shortfall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao led an army beyond the passes against the Hui rebels, and Henan supplied its pay in full without fail.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，卒，賜卹，諡敏肅。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he died; mourning favors were granted; his posthumous title was Minsu.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Guangxu, received mourning honors, and was given the posthumous name Minsu.

sentences.zh: =吳元柄=吳元柄，字子建，河南固始人。

translations.literal: Wu Yuanbing, style name Zijian, was a native of Gushi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuanbing, whose style was Zijian, came from Gushi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年進士，選庶吉士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he passed the jinshi examination and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the tenth year of Xianfeng and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 從團練大臣毛昶熙回籍治團練，從解固始圍，擊退息縣竄匪，擒捻首陳得一。

translations.literal: He followed militia commissioner Mao Changxi home to organize militia, took part in relieving the siege of Gushi, drove off bandits who fled into Xi County, and captured the Nian chief Chen Deyi.
translations.idiomatic: He followed militia commissioner Mao Changxi home to organize militia, helped lift the siege of Gushi, drove raiders out of Xi County, and captured Nian chief Chen Deyi.

sentences.zh: 十一年，汝寧捻首陳大喜竄居霍莊寨，元炳偕道員張曜攻克之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the Runing Nian chief Chen Daxi fled to Huozhuang Stockade; Yuanbing together with Circuit Intendant Zhang Yao captured it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Runing Nian leader Chen Daxi held Huozhuang Stockade, and Yuanbing with Zhang Yao took it.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，巡撫嚴樹森奏：「元柄驍捷善戰，所向有功，軍中最得力，請散館後仍令回河南。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Governor Yan Shusen memorialized: "Yuanbing is fierce, swift, and skilled in battle, successful wherever he goes, the most effective in the army; after leaving the Hanlin academy please still order him back to Henan."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi governor Yan Shusen wrote: "Yuanbing is bold, swift, and skilled in battle, successful wherever he fights, and the most effective officer in the army. After he leaves the Hanlin academy, please keep him in Henan."

sentences.zh: 」命免散館授檢討，仍留河南委用。

translations.literal: " He was ordered exempted from leaving the academy, appointed reviser, and still retained for service in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: " He was exempted from the usual Hanlin graduation, appointed reviser, and kept for service in Henan.

sentences.zh: 大喜負固平輿，其黨踞李旗屯，元炳偕張曜先平伊莊、陳莊、劉樓賊壘，乘勝下李旗屯，進攻楊樓，破之。

translations.literal: Daxi held out stubbornly at Pingyu; his followers occupied Liqitun; Yuanbing with Zhang Yao first pacified the rebel forts at Yizhuang, Chenzhuang, and Liulou, took advantage of victory to descend on Liqitun, advanced to attack Yanglou, and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: Daxi held Pingyu stubbornly while his men held Liqitun. Yuanbing and Zhang Yao first took Yizhuang, Chenzhuang, and Liulou, then swept into Liqitun and broke Yanglou.

sentences.zh: 旋克平輿，殲捻首張鳳林。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Pingyu was captured and the Nian chief Zhang Fenglin was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyu soon fell and Nian chief Zhang Fenglin was killed.

sentences.zh: 二年，克張岡賊巢，汝南肅清，擢侍講。

translations.literal: In the second year the rebel nest at Zhanggang was captured, Runan was pacified, and he was promoted to Hanlin lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the rebel base at Zhanggang was taken, Runan was pacified, and he was promoted to Hanlin lecturer.

sentences.zh: 尋攻息縣鮑家寨，克之。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he attacked Baojiazhai in Xi County and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He soon attacked Baojiazhai in Xi County and took it.

sentences.zh: 三年，拔譚家圩，附近賊寨，次第削平。

translations.literal: In the third year he took Tanjia Stockade and the nearby rebel stockades were successively suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he took Tanjia Stockade, and nearby rebel camps were suppressed one after another.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，回籍，巡撫張之萬奏起赴軍。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for his mother and returned home; Governor Zhang Zhiwan memorialized recalling him to the army.
translations.idiomatic: He went home to mourn his mother, and governor Zhang Zhiwan had him recalled to the army.

sentences.zh: 四年，以汝、光諸地稍定，請終制，允之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, as Runing, Guangzhou, and other areas were somewhat settled, he requested to complete mourning; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, with Runing and Guangzhou somewhat settled, he asked to complete mourning and was allowed to do so.

sentences.zh: 六年，補原官。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he resumed his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he returned to his former post.

sentences.zh: 九年，超擢侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was specially promoted to Hanlin expositor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he received a special promotion to Hanlin expositor.

sentences.zh: 十年，命署湖南布政使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was ordered to act as Hunan provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed acting Hunan provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢湖北巡撫，調安徽，再調江蘇。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to governor of Hubei, transferred to Anhui, and then transferred again to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he became governor of Hubei, then was transferred to Anhui and later to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，疏陳：「銀捐新例，新班遇缺先及遇缺兩項，得缺最速，流弊亦多，於政體大有關係，不可不嚴防其弊。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he memorialized: "Under the new silver-contribution regulations, the categories of new-class priority in vacancies and priority in vacancies obtain office fastest, but abuses are also numerous; this bears greatly on the political order and the abuses must be strictly guarded against."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu he wrote: "Under the new contribution rules, the priority categories for new donors gain office fastest but also produce the worst abuses. This bears heavily on governance and must be strictly controlled."

sentences.zh: 請明定章程，變通辦理。

translations.literal: I beg that regulations be clearly fixed and handled with flexible adjustment.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that clear rules be set and applied flexibly.

sentences.zh: 」下部議行。

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated and implemented it.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry deliberated and put the changes into effect.

sentences.zh: 山東、安徽比歲饑民流及淮、揚，元炳截漕撫卹，並疏高寶河、鹽運河，以工代賑。

translations.literal: In recent years famine victims from Shandong and Anhui had flowed to the Huai and Yang regions; Yuanbing diverted grain transport for relief and also dredged the Gaobao River and Salt Transport Canal, using labor projects in place of relief distributions.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years famine refugees from Shandong and Anhui had flooded the Huai-Yang region. Yuanbing diverted transport grain for relief, dredged the Gaobao and Salt Transport canals, and used public works in place of direct relief.

sentences.zh: 署兩江總督者三，兼署江蘇學政者一。

translations.literal: He acted as governor-general of the Two Jiangs three times and also once as Jiangsu education commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served three times as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs and once as acting Jiangsu education commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七年，丁本生母憂，去官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he entered mourning for his biological mother and left office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he left office to mourn his biological mother.

sentences.zh: 十年，入覲，命察山東河工、海防，授漕運總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he had an audience at court, was ordered to inspect Shandong river works and coastal defense, and was appointed director-general of grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he had an audience at court, was sent to inspect Shandong river works and coastal defense, and was appointed director-general of grain transport.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was made governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒，賜卹。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died and mourning favors were granted.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year and received mourning honors.

sentences.zh: 河南巡撫倪文蔚疏陳元炳戰功，遺愛在民，請於汝寧建專祠。

translations.literal: Henan Governor Ni Wenwei memorialized stating Yuanbing's battle achievements and that his kindness remained among the people, and requested a dedicated shrine at Runing.
translations.idiomatic: Henan governor Ni Wenwei reported Yuanbing's military achievements and the affection the people still bore him, and asked for a dedicated shrine at Runing.

sentences.zh: =論=論曰：李僡守山東，吳棠保江淮，當時皆負時望。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Li Hui defended Shandong and Wu Tang protected the Jiang-Huai region; at the time both bore the hopes of the age.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: Li Hui held Shandong and Wu Tang guarded the Jiang-Huai line; both carried the hopes of their time.

sentences.zh: 英翰剿捻，戰績最多，及任皖疆，甚得民心。

translations.literal: Ying Han suppressed the Nian with the most battle achievements, and when he governed the Anhui frontier he won the people's hearts deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Han's record against the Nian was the greatest, and as governor of Anhui he won deep popular affection.

sentences.zh: 劉蓉抱負非常，佐駱秉章平蜀，優於謀略而短於專將，治陝不竟其功。

translations.literal: Liu Rong had extraordinary ambition; he assisted Luo Bingzhang in pacifying Shu, was superior in strategy but weak as an independent commander, and in governing Shaanxi did not complete his achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Rong had unusual ability. He helped Luo Bingzhang pacify Sichuan, was stronger in strategy than in independent command, and did not finish his work in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 喬松年在皖倚用英翰而奏績，在陝不能與劉蓉和衷，徒促僨事。

translations.literal: Qiao Songnian in Anhui relied on Ying Han and reported achievements; in Shaanxi he could not work in harmony with Liu Rong and only hastened failure.
translations.idiomatic: In Anhui Qiao Songnian relied on Ying Han and achieved results; in Shaanxi he could not work with Liu Rong and only made matters worse.

sentences.zh: 錢鼎銘慷慨乞師，為平吳之引導，治豫亦有聲。

translations.literal: Qian Dingming boldly begged for troops and was the guide to pacifying Wu; in governing Henan he also had renown.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Dingming's bold plea for relief opened the way to pacifying Wu, and he was also celebrated for governing Henan.

sentences.zh: 吳元炳以詞林事軍旅，其際遇特異焉。

translations.literal: Wu Yuanbing from the Hanlin entered military service; his career was especially unusual.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuanbing, a Hanlin scholar who took up military service, had a career of unusual distinction.
